subject: Error in geom_bar with categorical data

messages.author: 2401d0740178cf07
messages.subject: Error in geom_bar with categorical data
parts:
Dear R-colleagues,


  I need some help to produce a plot pretty much like this one: https://www.dropbox.com/s/8p3g42c54w3dnof/Untitled.png.


  My dataset contains categorical data along many years (actually, 402 -  from climate simulations). Here is the link to download the file with the data: https://dl.dropbox.com/s/50loxmtd2z2eqco/rcp26.csv?dl=1 (first column can be ignored). Instead of area (hectares), like in the picture of the link above, my data contains the frequency of 13 classes in each one of the 402 years.


  At this point, this is what I am trying to do:


# Load required package

require (ggplot2)


# Read data

dump <- read.csv ('~/Dropbox/web/rcp26.csv')


# Try to plot data

ggplot (dump, aes(dump$value, fill=c(dump$X1700,dump$X2005,dump$X2099))) + geom_bar(position="dodge")

Error: Aesthetics must either be length one, or the same length as the dataProblems:dump$value


  I need some help to reproduce a plot (https://www.dropbox.com/s/8p3g42c54w3dnof/Untitled.png) using my data, but with years 1700, 2005 e 2099 (contained in my data), instead of 1985, 1993 e 2005.


  Any help is appreciated. Many thanks in advance,

  Thiago.

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Error in geom_bar with categorical data
parts:
Hi Thiago, see if this works for you:

dump <- dump[c("value","X1700","X2005","X2099")] # trim to just data we want
names(dump)[1] <- "Classes" # rename first column
library(reshape)
dump <- melt(dump,id.vars=1) # melt so in a form convenient for ggplot
dump$Year <- substr(dump$variable,2,5) # nice-looking year

library(ggplot2)
qplot(as.factor(Classes),value,fill=Year,geom="bar",data=dump,position="dodge")


Ben

messages.subject: Re: Error in geom_bar with categorical data
parts:
Hi Ben,

  Thanks for the fast response. Brilliant solution! It's just what I was looking for.

  One last question: do you know whether ggplot2 also provides any function to display relative histogram (i.e. percentage of total), rather than count data?

  Below is a updated version of the code, based on your tips:

# load required packages
library (reshape)
library (ggplot2)

# read data
dump <- read.csv ('~/Dropbox/web/rcp85.csv')

# trim to just data we want
dump <- dump[c("value", "X1700", "X2005", "X2099")]

# rename first column
names(dump)[1] <- "Classes"

# melt so in a form convenient for ggplot
dump <- melt(dump, id.vars=1)

# nice-looking year
dump$Year <- substr(dump$variable,2,5)

# plot data
qplot(as.factor(Classes), value, fill=Year, geom="bar", data=dump, position="dodge")

  Best,
  Thiago.

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Error in geom_bar with categorical data
parts:
Hi Thiago,

Glad it was useful. Note that geom_histogram is just an alias for
stat_bin plus geom_bar, basically; I believe that you can do something
like this for a relative histogram:

p <- ggplot( dump, aes( as.factor( Classes ), value ) )
p + stat_bin(aes(y=..density..*binwidth), position="dodge", binwidth=binwidth)

...where 'binwidth' is whatever you want. I haven't tested
this--sorry, can't right now--but think it will do what you want.

Ben
